content: Embodiment of the four kāyas, omniscient Kinsman of the Sun,Amitāyus, Amitābha, and the supreme noble Avalokiteśvara,Mañjughoṣa, Lord of Secrets, and Tārā with a wrathful frown,Together with the assembly of the Victors and their Bodhisattva heirs—The seven great patriarchs, the six ornaments, and the two supreme ones,The eighty mahāsiddhas, the sixteen elders, and all the rest,Who strive solely for the benefit of the teachings and sentient beings—Supreme beings and bodhisattvas, I pray you, attend to me without exception.By the Supreme Sage, who throughout countless eons,Perfected the two accumulations of merit and wisdom,And by the power of the truth of his ultimate knowledge, love, and capacity,May the complete teachings of the Victorious One blaze for a long time to come.The gateway to the light of the Buddha’s teachings in the Land of Snows,Was first opened by the Abbot, the Master, and the Dharma King—this trio.Through the power of the aspirations of the translators, scholars, vidyādharas, and the king and his subjects,May the Victor’s teachings in the Land of Snows blaze for a long time to come.Within the pavilion of the vast jewels of the Word,The great Dharma treasures of the profound classes of practice,The profound and vast Heart-Essence shines with intense, sharp light;May the Victor’s teachings in the Land of Snows blaze for a long time to come.Within the vast expanse of the essence of primordially pure luminosity,The pinnacle of vehicles that holistically contains all phenomena of samsara and nirvana,Is the means for traversing to the primordial sovereign state of Samantabhadra;May the Victor’s teachings in the Land of Snows blaze for a long time to come.The lineages of the profound view and the vast conduct,Atiśa, who possessed the treasury of complete instructions,The tradition of teachings originating from the Source of the Victorious One;May the Victor’s teachings in the Land of Snows blaze for a long time to come.The Victor’s Word, comprised of the three scriptural collections,Perfectly arranged as instructions for the three types of individuals,The golden rosary of the Kadampas, possessing the seven divine dharmas;May the Victor’s teachings in the Land of Snows blaze for a long time to come.The translator Marpa, Bźad-pa-rdo-rje, and the rest,The source of blessings, the jewel-like treasury of the Kagyü,The wondrous tradition of an unrivaled succession of masters;May the Victor’s teachings in the Land of Snows blaze for a long time to come.All phenomena of samsara and nirvana are the radiance of coemergent mind,Realize that mind-essence, free from conceptual elaboration, is the nature of the Dharmakaya,The Mahamudra that pervades all of appearance and existence, samsara and nirvana;May the Victor’s teachings in the Land of Snows blaze for a long time to come.The essential points of the hundreds of scriptures on outer and inner sciences, sutras, and tantras,Expertly preserved through explanation, debate, and composition by those who uphold the Buddha's teachings,The Sakyapa of the divine Khön lineage, masters of great compassion;May the Victor’s teachings in the Land of Snows blaze for a long time to come.The oral instructions of the whispered lineage, possessing the four validities,The most profound key points of the practice of Cause, Path, and Result,The tradition of the special instructions of the Lord of Yogis;May the Victor’s teachings in the Land of Snows blaze for a long time to come.Closely connected with the profound view of the Middle Way,The path of the two stages of the Great Secret Vajrayana,The teachings of the Victorious Lobsang, skilled in weaving the profound and the luminous;May the Victor’s teachings in the Land of Snows blaze for a long time to come.The meaning of the three baskets and the four classes of tantra,The nature and sequential stages of the entire path,The supreme, excellent system for practicing without error;May the Victor’s teachings in the Land of Snows blaze for a long time to come.With a tradition of explanation unlike any other sutra or tantra,Of the outer, inner, and alternative Kālacakra,The dual system of Bu and Jo holding the lineage of scripture and realization;May the Victor’s teachings in the Land of Snows blaze for a long time to come.In short, the ten great pillars of the explanatory lineage,The chariots of the practice lineage in general, such as Zhije and the rest,Rich with numerous pith instructions that unify Sutra and Mantra;May the Victor’s teachings in the Land of Snows blaze for a long time to come.May the lives of the doctrine-holders be firm and the Sangha be in harmony,May the teachings be sustained by the three wheels of activity,May the earth be filled with beings who have faith in the teachings;May the non-sectarian teachings of the Victor blaze for a long time to come.Throughout the world, may the names of war, famine, and strife,And even the mention of cruel thoughts or deeds, never be heard;May sentient beings possess love, and the excellence of the world and its inhabitants increase,And may an ocean of joy and happiness pervade all directions.From this day forward, may I follow the path of the complete teachings,Through the vast awakening mind and the profound view,By single-mindedly persevering in study, reflection, and meditation,May I swiftly reach the ground of immediate and lasting happiness.For the sake of all sentient beings, as infinite as the reaches of space,In the charming conduct of the King of Sages and his heirs,Free from discouragement, base attachments, and laziness,May I engage with the joyful enthusiasm of faith and aspiration.May my body, my enjoyments, and all my virtues,Become the cause of happiness for all mother beings;And whatever suffering and origins of suffering they may have,May all of those ripen fully upon me.May all who see, hear, remember, or are inspired by me,Always enjoy the splendor of happiness and joy;And may even those who insult, strike, or speak ill of me,All be endowed with the fortune of the path to enlightenment.In short, for as long as space remains,And for as long as the suffering of beings persists,May I also remain, and through means both direct and indirect,Become a source of benefit and happiness.
